page.overview:
Who is Lo Fat?

Lo Fat is a character from the Street Fighter TV series. He is an evil crime lord who leads a gang called The Syndicate and threatens Fei Long and those who he knows.

On two occurrances, Fat had arranged set ups. In the first, he sent his right hand man, Lord Zing, a crime boss, to have Raymond Wang, Fei Long's movie director, trick him into making a movie. In the second, he got a phone call from one of his spies. However, Fei Long hopes that someday, he will be stopped.

Lo Fat is voiced by Garry Chalk in "Dark Heart" and by Scott McNeil in "So, You Want to Be in Pictures." Category:Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Street Fighter Animated Series Characters Category:Non Video Game Characters Category:Antagonists Category:Shadaloo
